ActionDescriptions.ToGenerateLazySkillIndex:
to validate a lazy ProtoScript skill
skillName - exact installed skill directory name. writeSidecar - true to atomically write index.pts.lazy.json after successful lightweight-project compilation; false to validate without mutation. This does not publish or install the skill.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetBuffalySkillDirectoryEntry:
to inspect a remote Buffaly skill
skillName - exact SkillName from the official Skill Directory entry.
ActionDescriptions.ToInstallBuffalySkillFromDirectory:
to install a remote Buffaly skill
skillName - exact remote SkillName. replaceExisting - true only when intentionally replacing an existing local skill folder. enableAfterInstall - true to add the installed skill to Skills/index.pts after download. Installation writes supported package files but does not execute the skill.
ActionDescriptions.ToPreviewBuffalyExtensionProfileUpdate:
to check a Buffaly extension profile update
profileId - exact instance extension profile id. repositorySource - Local or Remote.
ActionDescriptions.ToPreviewBuffalySkillDirectoryInstall:
to dry run Buffaly skill install
skillName - exact remote SkillName. replaceExisting - true only when intentionally replacing an existing local skill folder. This does not install or run anything.
ActionDescriptions.ToPreviewInstalledBuffalyExtensionUpdate:
to check all Buffaly extensions for updates
sourceId - repository source id, normally BuffalyPublic or blank for default. repositorySource - Local or Remote. packageType - optional Skill, WebModule, or ProviderModule filter; blank checks all package types.
ActionDescriptions.ToPreviewPublishSkillToBuffalySkillRepos:
to validate publishing a Buffaly skill
skillName - exact installed skill directory name. replaceExisting - true when previewing replacement of an existing owner-repository payload. This validates lazy skills but does not write, commit, push, or install anything.
ActionDescriptions.ToPublishSkillToBuffalySkillRepository:
to publish a Buffaly skill
skillName - exact installed skill directory name. replaceExisting - true to replace an existing owner-repository payload. commitChanges and pushChanges are explicit source-control choices; pushChanges requires commitChanges. Publishing validates and writes a lazy sidecar when the active project declares the skill lazy, but does not install the package into an environment.
ActionDescriptions.ToSearchBuffalySkillDirectory:
to list remote Buffaly skills
searchText - optional text to match against official remote skills. Use an empty string to list all official skills.
ActionDescriptions.ToUpdateBuffalyExtensionProfile:
to update all Buffaly personal extensions
profileId - exact instance extension profile id. repositorySource - Local or Remote. dryRun - true previews without mutation. allowPreStartInstall - true only during a controlled stopped-instance update.
ActionDescriptions.ToUpdateInstalledBuffalyExtensions:
to apply installed Buffaly extension updates
sourceId - repository source id, normally BuffalyPublic or blank for default. repositorySource - Local or Remote. packageType - optional Skill, WebModule, or ProviderModule filter; blank updates all package types. dryRun - true previews without mutation. allowPreStartInstall - true only during a controlled stopped-instance update; live use queues WebModule/ProviderModule pre-start installs instead of overwriting loaded files.
